description: Write a shared doc's tab: its whole new Markdown (`md`), a rename (`name`), a delete or restore (`deleted`), or, without `tab`, a new tab called `name`. `base` must be the stamp you read with doc_read. If the tab changed since, nothing is posted and you get `applied: false` with the current stamp, who changed it, and the current text: merge your change into it and write again with the new stamp. Never drop the other writer's changes.

base.description:
The stamp doc_read gave for that tab (e.g. "v3·9fa2c1d0"). Required
with `tab`. If the tab changed since, nothing is posted.

deleted.description: true deletes the tab (its text is kept), false restores it.

md.description: The tab's whole new text. Leave out to keep it (to rename, delete or restore).

name.description: A new name, or the name of a new tab.

note.description: What changed, for history and for the others.

tab.description: The tab to write (name or id). Leave out to create a tab named `name`.

to.description: Participants to wake (names, keys or role:<role>).

name: doc_write
